svg.title: 49. Toe spread stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Sit with both feet resting on the floor. Spread your toes gently to make space between them. Hold the open position and then relax.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.athletico.com/2016/09/07/stretch-week-toe-spread-stretch/
